children: September Richmond Manufacturing Index: -2 vs. -1 consensus and 4 in August, according to data released by the Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond on Tuesday.
Two of its three component indexes decreased in September: shipments to -5 from 11 and new orders to -6 from 3. Meanwhile, the employment index increased to 7 from -2.
The future indexes for shipments and new orders remained firmly in positive territory. The expectations index for employment dropped notably to 8 in September from 20 in August.
The local business conditions decreased from 4 in August to -6 in September. Meanwhile, the future local business conditions index continued to fall, to 10 from 16.

title: Richmond Fed Manufacturing Index slips more than expected in September
